gold_diagnosis: congenital unilateral hypoplasia of depressor anguli oris

1: The patient's symptoms of facial asymmetry noted since birth, right lower lip deviating inward when smiling or crying, and symmetric facial movement at rest are consistent with Congenital Unilateral Lower Lip Palsy. The normal neurodevelopmental examination also supports this diagnosis.

The patient's right lower lip deviation when smiling, symmetric facial movement at rest, and normal auditory brainstem response test are consistent with Isolated Unilateral Congenital Lower Lip Paresis.
